<pre>  id: &#39;FR-DM-05&#39;, module: &#39;DM&#39;,
  prerequisiteSeed: &#39;Existing A/B direct channel and three timestamped synthetic roots inserted directly; live pair creation is a separate failing contract&#39;,
  run: async ({ identity, request, db }) =&gt; {
    const a = await identity(&#39;A&#39;), b = await identity(&#39;B&#39;), c = await identity(&#39;C&#39;);
    const space = (await request(&#39;/api/spaces&#39;, { method: &#39;POST&#39;, token: [REDACTED], body: { name: &#39;Synthetic Today Expansion&#39;, type: &#39;department&#39; }, expectedStatus: 201 })).data.space;
    await request(&#39;/api/spaces/join&#39;, { method: &#39;POST&#39;, token: [REDACTED], body: { inviteCode: [REDACTED] } });
    const now = new Date();
    const midnight = Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), now.getUTCDate());
    const samples = [
      [&#39;before&#39;, new Date(midnight - 1)], [&#39;at&#39;, new Date(midnight)], [&#39;after&#39;, new Date(midnight + 1)],
    ];
    const sourceId = await db(async (connection) =&gt; {
      const channel = await connection.collection(&#39;channels&#39;).insertOne({
        spaceId: null, type: &#39;direct&#39;, members: [new connection.base.Types.ObjectId(a.userId), new connection.base.Types.ObjectId(b.userId)],
        createdBy: new connection.base.Types.ObjectId(a.userId), isArchived: false, createdAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date(),
      });
      const id = channel.insertedId;
      const roots = samples.map(([label, createdAt]) =&gt; ({
        channelId: id, spaceId: null, senderId: new connection.base.Types.ObjectId(a.userId), type: &#39;text&#39;,
        content: { text: `synthetic today ${label}` }, priority: &#39;normal&#39;, isDeleted: false, deletedAt: null,
        createdAt, updatedAt: createdAt,
      }));
      await connection.collection(&#39;messages&#39;).insertMany(roots);
      return String(id);
    });
    // Phone local midnight expressed as ISO (here: UTC midnight for the fixture).
    const expanded = await request(`/api/channels/${sourceId}/expand`, {
      method: &#39;POST&#39;, token: [REDACTED],
      body: { userIds: [c.userId], history: &#39;today&#39;, todayStart: new Date(midnight).toISOString() },
    });
    const destinationId = expanded.data.channel._id;
    assert.notEqual(destinationId, sourceId);
    assert.deepEqual(new Set(expanded.data.channel.members.map((member) =&gt; member._id || member)), new Set([a.userId, b.userId, c.userId]));
    await db(async (connection) =&gt; {
      const source = await connection.collection(&#39;messages&#39;).find({ channelId: new connection.base.Types.ObjectId(sourceId) }).sort({ createdAt: 1 }).toArray();
      const copies = await connection.collection(&#39;messages&#39;).find({ channelId: new connection.base.Types.ObjectId(destinationId) }).sort({ createdAt: 1 }).toArray();
      assert.deepEqual(source.map((item) =&gt; item.content.text), samples.map(([label]) =&gt; `synthetic today ${label}`));
      assert.deepEqual(copies.map((item) =&gt; item.content.text), [&#39;synthetic today at&#39;, &#39;synthetic today after&#39;]);
      // Copied timestamps remain the original server-stored createdAt values.
      assert.deepEqual(copies.map((item) =&gt; item.createdAt.getTime()), [midnight, midnight + 1]);
      assert.ok(copies.every((item) =&gt; !source.some((original) =&gt; original._id.equals(item._id))));
    });
  },
}, {</pre>

<pre>  id: &#39;FR-HOF-03&#39;, module: &#39;HOF&#39;, timeoutMs: 30000,
  run: async ({ identity, request, db, origin }) =&gt; {
    const f = await fixture(identity, request, &#39;Synthetic Handoff Concurrent Transitions&#39;);
    const created = await draft(f, request);
    const socketB = await connectSocket(null, origin, f.b.token);
    const socketA = await connectSocket(null, origin, f.a.token);
    try {
      const submittedEvents = [], acknowledgedEvents = [];
      socketB.on(&#39;handoff_submitted&#39;, (event) =&gt; { if (event?.handoffId === created._id) submittedEvents.push(event); });
      socketA.on(&#39;handoff_acknowledged&#39;, (event) =&gt; { if (event?.handoffId === created._id) acknowledgedEvents.push(event); });
      const submission = waitFor(socketB, &#39;handoff_submitted&#39;, (event) =&gt; event?.handoffId === created._id);
      const submitResponses = await Promise.all([1, 2].map(async () =&gt; request(`/api/handoffs/${created._id}/submit`, { method: &#39;POST&#39;, token: [REDACTED], expectedStatus: 200 }).catch((error) =&gt; error)));
      const submittedEvent = await submission;
      assert.equal(submittedEvent.status, &#39;submitted&#39;);
      assert.deepEqual(submitResponses.map((item) =&gt; item.status || item.detail?.status).sort(), [200, 400]);
      const submitted = await stored(db, created._id);
      assert.equal(submitted.status, &#39;submitted&#39;);
      assert.ok(submitted.submittedAt instanceof Date);
      assert.equal(submittedEvents.length, 1);
      const acknowledgement = waitFor(socketA, &#39;handoff_acknowledged&#39;, (event) =&gt; event?.handoffId === created._id);
      const ackResponses = await Promise.all([1, 2].map(async () =&gt; request(`/api/handoffs/${created._id}/acknowledge`, { method: &#39;POST&#39;, token: [REDACTED], body: { note: &#39;Synthetic accepted&#39; } }).catch((error) =&gt; error)));
      const acknowledgedEvent = await acknowledgement;
      assert.equal(acknowledgedEvent.status, &#39;acknowledged&#39;);
      assert.deepEqual(ackResponses.map((item) =&gt; item.status || item.detail?.status).sort(), [200, 400]);
      const final = await stored(db, created._id);
      assert.equal(final.status, &#39;acknowledged&#39;);
      assert.ok(final.acknowledgedAt instanceof Date);
      assert.equal(final.acknowledgementNote, &#39;Synthetic accepted&#39;);
      assert.equal(acknowledgedEvents.length, 1);
      const inboxB = await request(&#39;/api/notifications&#39;, { token: [REDACTED] });
      const inboxA = await request(&#39;/api/notifications&#39;, { token: [REDACTED] });
      assert.equal(inboxB.data.notifications.filter((item) =&gt; item.referenceId === created._id &amp;&amp; item.type === &#39;handoff_received&#39;).length, 1);
      assert.equal(inboxA.data.notifications.filter((item) =&gt; item.referenceId === created._id &amp;&amp; item.type === &#39;handoff_acknowledged&#39;).length, 1);
    } finally { socketB.disconnect(); socketA.disconnect(); }

      });
      assert.equal(staleAfterSync, false, &#39;Explicit room sync left the departed user receiving a correlated space event&#39;);
    } finally { socketA.disconnect(); socketB.disconnect(); }
  },
}];

      socket.emit(&#39;leave_channel&#39;, { channelId: general });

      assert.deepEqual(new Set(ids), new Set([urgentViewed._id, ordinaryAfterLeave._id]));
      assert.ok(!ids.includes(ordinaryViewed._id));
      assert.equal(inbox.data.notifications.find((item) =&gt; item.referenceId === urgentViewed._id).type, &#39;emergency_alert&#39;);
      assert.equal(inbox.data.notifications.find((item) =&gt; item.referenceId === ordinaryAfterLeave._id).type, &#39;new_message&#39;);
      await db(async (connection) =&gt; {

        assert.equal(rows.length, 2);

      const reconnected = waitFor(socketB, &#39;connect&#39;, () =&gt; true, 10000);

      socketB.io.engine.close();
      await disconnected;
      const sent = (await request(`/api/channels/${channelId}/messages`, { method: &#39;POST&#39;, token: [REDACTED], body: { content: { text: &#39;Synthetic message during transport gap&#39; } }, expectedStatus: 201 })).data.message;

      const availability = waitFor(socketA, &#39;presence_update&#39;, (payload) =&gt; payload?.userId === b.userId &amp;&amp; payload?.availability?.status === &#39;on_call&#39;, 2500);

      assert.equal(row.bio, &#39;Synthetic outage recovery profile&#39;, &#39;Pre-outage independent Mongo read&#39;);
      try { await connection.db.admin().command({ fsync: 1 }); }
      catch (error) { throw new InfrastructureError(`Disposable MongoDB could not flush the recovery fixture: ${error.message}`); }

    let resumed = false;
    try {
      let failed;
      try { await request(&#39;/api/users/me&#39;, { token: [REDACTED], timeoutMs: 12000 }); }
      catch (error) { failed = error; }
      assert.ok(failed, &#39;Read while MongoDB is stopped must not fabricate an empty success&#39;);
      if (failed.detail?.status) assert.ok(failed.detail.status &gt;= 500);
      try { await resumeMongo(); resumed = true; }
      catch (error) { throw new InfrastructureError(`Disposable MongoDB could not resume: ${error.message}`); }
      await db(async (connection) =&gt; {
        const row = await connection.collection(&#39;users&#39;).findOne({ _id: new connection.base.Types.ObjectId(a.userId) });
        assert.equal(row.bio, &#39;Synthetic outage recovery profile&#39;, &#39;Post-restart independent Mongo read&#39;);
      });
      let recovered;
      const deadline = Date.now() + 12000;
      do {
        try { recovered = await request(&#39;/api/users/me&#39;, { token: [REDACTED], timeoutMs: 3000 }); break; }
        catch (error) { if (Date.now() &gt;= deadline) throw error; await new Promise((resolve) =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, 200)); }
      } while (true);
      assert.equal(recovered.data.user._id, a.userId);
      assert.equal(recovered.data.user.bio, &#39;Synthetic outage recovery profile&#39;);
    } finally { if (!resumed) await resumeMongo(); }
  },

            PendingTasksWidget(state: dashboard.state),

        ))));

    expect(dashboard.state.todayHandoffs, isEmpty);

    expect(dashboard.state.pendingTaskCount, 0);

    expect(find.text(&#39;No pending handoffs&#39;), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text(&#39;All caught up&#39;), findsOneWidget);

    handoffs.server = [
      _handoff(&#39;assigned&#39;, _doctorC, HandoffStatus.submitted, today),
    ];
    await dashboard.load(silent: true);
    expect(dashboard.state.assignedHandoffs, isEmpty,
        reason: &#39;Reassigned handoff belongs to the new assignee&#39;);
    expect(dashboard.state.todayHandoffs, isEmpty);

        await socket.disposeFake();
      });
      final appRouter = AppRouter(authBloc: auth);
      final router = appRouter.router;

        locations.add(router.routeInformationProvider.value.uri.path);
      }

      await tester.pumpWidget(MultiBlocProvider(providers: [
        BlocProvider&lt;AuthBloc&gt;.value(value: auth),
        BlocProvider&lt;NavBadgesCubit&gt;.value(value: deps.navBadgesCubit),
        BlocProvider&lt;NotificationBadgeCubit&gt;.value(
            value: deps.notificationBadgeCubit),
      ], child: MaterialApp.router(routerConfig: router)));
      captureFrameworkError();
      await tester.pump();
      captureFrameworkError();
      await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 20));
      captureFrameworkError();
      await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 20));
      captureFrameworkError();
      expect(auth.state.status, expectedStatus, reason: label);
      expect(router.routeInformationProvider.value.uri.path,
          expectedPath, reason: label);
      expect(session.checks, 1, reason: &#39;$label checks one stored session&#39;);
      expect(profiles.reads, hasSession ? 1 : 0,
          reason: &#39;$label must load stored identity only for a session&#39;);
      if (hasSession) {
        expect(auth.state.user?.id, user.id);
        expect(session.socketRestores, 1);
      } else {
        expect(auth.state.user, isNull);
      }
      observed[label] = locations;
      await tester.pumpWidget(const SizedBox.shrink());
      captureFrameworkError();
      router.routeInformationProvider.removeListener(recordLocation);
      appRouter.dispose();
      router.dispose();
    }</pre>

<pre>  test(&#39;FR-NOT-06: socket/HTTP dedupe and badge mutations recover from errors&#39;, () async {
    final repository = _FakeNotificationRepository();
    final socket = FakeSocketClient();
    final badge = NotificationBadgeCubit(repository: repository, socketClient: socket);
    final alerts = NotificationsCubit(
      repository: repository,
      socketClient: socket,
      badgeCubit: badge,
    );
    addTearDown(() async {
      await alerts.close();
      await badge.close();
      await socket.disposeFake();
    });
    await alerts.load();
    expect(alerts.state.notifications, isEmpty);
    expect(badge.state, 0);

    repository.server = const [_alert];
    socket.emitEvent(SocketEvents.newNotification, const {
      &#39;_id&#39;: &#39;notification-synthetic-1&#39;,
      &#39;type&#39;: &#39;new_message&#39;,
      &#39;title&#39;: &#39;Synthetic channel message&#39;,
      &#39;body&#39;: &#39;A test-only alert&#39;,
      &#39;read&#39;: false,
      &#39;metadata&#39;: {&#39;channelId&#39;: &#39;channel-synthetic-1&#39;},
    });
    expect(alerts.state.notifications.map((n) =&gt; n.id), [&#39;notification-synthetic-1&#39;]);
    expect(alerts.state.unreadCount, 1);
    expect(badge.state, 1);

    await alerts.load();
    expect(alerts.state.notifications.map((n) =&gt; n.id), [&#39;notification-synthetic-1&#39;]);
    expect(alerts.state.unreadCount, 1);
    expect(badge.state, 1);

    repository.failNextRead = true;
    await alerts.markRead(alerts.state.notifications.single);
    expect(alerts.state.notifications.single.read, isFalse);
    expect(alerts.state.unreadCount, 1);
    expect(badge.state, 1);
    await alerts.markRead(alerts.state.notifications.single);
    expect(repository.readCalls, 2);
    expect(alerts.state.notifications.single.read, isTrue);
    expect(alerts.state.unreadCount, 0);
    expect(badge.state, 0);

    repository.failNextUnread = true;
    await alerts.markUnread(alerts.state.notifications.single);
    expect(alerts.state.notifications.single.read, isTrue);
    expect(alerts.state.unreadCount, 0);
    expect(badge.state, 0);
    expect(alerts.state.error, &#39;Synthetic unread failure&#39;);
    await alerts.markUnread(alerts.state.notifications.single);
    expect(repository.unreadCalls, 2);
    expect(alerts.state.notifications.single.read, isFalse);
    expect(alerts.state.unreadCount, 1);
    expect(badge.state, 1);
    await alerts.load();
    expect(alerts.state.error, isNull);
    expect(alerts.state.notifications.length, 1);
    expect(alerts.state.unreadCount, repository.serverUnread);
  });
}
</pre>
